issues.explanation: The diff adds LOG_DAILY_DAYS=14 to .env.example but shows no wiring of the daily channel days to env(LOG_DAILY_DAYS, 14), so the documented env key appears dead and the archive-retention requirement cannot be verified.
Logging tests assert default days/level values but never set LOG_DAILY_DAYS, LOG_AUDIT_LEVEL, or LOG_AUDIT_DAYS to non-defaults, so env configurability is unproven.
